selection_basis: First CSV row in the ECS-labelled stratum; mouse ID absent from the existing archive ledger. Chosen for input-contract feasibility, not event appearance or expected biological differences.
inspection_before_record: CSV and filenames reviewed; first TIFF header and page metadata at indices 0,1,2,1199 inspected. No image pixels or previous event outcomes inspected. Embedded prefix FB2411 conflicts with CSV/folder FB2412. Source timestamps depart from exact 1 Hz. Historical researcher inspection/tuning is unknown.
decision_to_inform: Can a source-bound local recording enter the same MATLAB preflight while retaining acquisition facts, unknowns and holds?
frozen_scope: One complete source movie, metadata inventory for all 20 CSV rows, zero detector runs, zero outcome tuning, no cohort pooling. Existing source and derived files remain unchanged.
technical_criteria: All CSV rows retained; source/staged SHA256 equality; frame metadata correspondence checked for every selected TIFF page; MATLAB reports unsupported timing without replacing timestamps. Technical success is not scientific acceptance.
budget: One metadata inventory and one selected-recording preflight. At most one correction of an import/export defect if needed; preserve failed evidence. Stage only the selected source movie and metadata, with no analysis workers.
stopping_rule: Stop after the preflight report. Preserve unresolved identity, timing semantics, calibration and signal preparation. A hold leads to an acquisition decision before a biological run, not a substitute case selected for a convenient outcome.
biological_acceptance_criteria: not established; no biological evaluation in this input check
